# =============================================================================
# BORUTA FEATURE SELECTION
# =============================================================================
# Edit the second column of each feature line:
#   INCLUDE  → feature is a Boruta candidate
#   EXCLUDE  → feature is never used
#
# Source tags (informational, do not edit):
#   [BSC]  = only available in BSC rain-event data (rf_dataset.csv)
#   [IRR]  = only available in irrigation data (irrigation_events_v2_all.csv)
#   [BOTH] = present in both datasets
#
# Rain event features [BSC]: configurable here, but they are never used for
#   irrigation models — those columns simply don't exist in irrigation data.
#
# Leakage columns (peak_vwc, t_peak_min, delta_pct_dyn, delta_vwc, dry_h,
# temp_sum) are omitted — they are never eligible features.
# Identifiers (eui, ev_start, ev_end, …) are also omitted.
#
# Depth-specific note: sensor stats (pre_vwc, dyn_range, avg_temp, vwc_p05,
#   vwc_p95) at non-target depths are always excluded regardless of this file.
#   This file controls whether the stat is used at the target depth at all.
# =============================================================================

# ── Sensor / per-depth statistics ──────────────────────────────────────
